Chapter 782: Chapter 7 Black Tower Sixth Layer (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 782: Chapter 7 Black Tower Sixth Layer (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

“With such talent and speed of cultivation, even when the Master of the Moyu Tower had not reached his ultimate form, he was far inferior,” Stone Statue Shen Ji thought to himself.

The Moyu Tower Master, who was able to establish the Moyu Tower, was naturally a peerless genius of his times, breaking a series of records before even becoming ultimate.

But to discern the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Tenth Rank? Even a genius like the Moyu Tower Master hadn’t achieved that.

Initially, the Moyu Tower Master had comprehended the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank, but as for understanding the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, that occurred only after stepping into the Eleventh Rank.

“Such a talented individual would be too great a loss if damaged while striving to reach his ultimate form,” Stone Statue Shen Ji showed a hint of hesitation on his face, and Lin Yuan was currently a core disciple of the Moyu Tower.

Essentially family.

...

If he could step into the Twelfth Rank, perhaps he could preserve the legacy of the Moyu Tower.

“Enough.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji made his decision.

…

Sixth Layer of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“A vast expanse of continuously merging timespaces…” Lin Yuan recognized the key to passing the sixth layer at a glance.

It was having a deep mastery of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, otherwise, even if one walked for a hundred thousand or a million years, reaching the ‘end’ would be impossible.

“I am now at the Dual Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, drawing upon the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule Comprehension of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses for reference, which brings my understanding on par with the Third Realm…”

This was akin to an open-book exam, where the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule Comprehension of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses was the ‘paper’, and Lin Yuan could ‘copy’ it even if he didn’t understand it temporarily.

Time passed.

Soon, half a day had gone by.

Lin Yuan stopped at the last step before the ‘end.

“Spatiotemporal fusion, so this is how it is.”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful as he slowly took the final step and arrived at the endpoint of the Black Tower’s sixth layer.

[Your comprehension is exceptional, observing the mingling of time and space, enhancing your grasp on the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…]

Having passed through the sixth layer of the Black Tower, Lin Yuan had a deeper understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, further enhanced by the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule Comprehension of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

Now, Lin Yuan had again improved in his mastery of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, not far from the peak of the Dual Realm.

“Congratulations, you’ve passed the sixth layer.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji had long been waiting at the ‘endpoint.’

His gaze towards Lin Yuan was unavoidably complicated, knowing well that Lin Yuan wouldn’t have attempted the sixth layer without being sure of it.

But actually witnessing a Tenth Rank life pass the sixth layer was still profoundly shocking.

Even during the prime times of the Moyu Tower, a Tenth Rank life passing the sixth layer of the Black Tower? It was absolutely unprecedented and extremely rare.

Not to mention, he did pass it.

“Why not try the seventh layer?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji asked.

“No need,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He found the sixth layer quite challenging, let alone attempting the seventh layer.

As for advancing his understanding through tackling the seventh layer? When the levels were too disparate, it became very hard to do.

The difference between the sixth and seventh layers of the Black Tower was a qualitative leap, and forcibly attempting to comprehend was less advantageous than observing the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule Comprehension of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

“Alright.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded.

“Now you have three opportunities to select a reward from me, corresponding to the rewards of the Second Layer, Fifth Layer, and Sixth Layer. Which one would you like to choose?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji asked.

“Let’s start with the Second Layer reward.”

Lin Yuan said, mentioning the Second Layer reward, but it was actually from the Third Layer reward vault.

When Lin Yuan had passed the Second Layer of the Black Tower, his performance was so exceptional that he directly qualified for the rewards from the Third Layer reward vault.

“Choose one from these rewards.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji waved his right hand, and a virtual light screen emerged, displaying various treasures and rare items.

Lin Yuan carefully looked for a while.

The opportunity to select the Second Layer reward was because Lin Yuan couldn’t find a suitable reward at that time, which is why he postponed this opportunity.

“This one.”

Lin Yuan chose the ‘Source of Metallicity’.

This rare treasure has significant effects on nurturing weapons. If Lin Yuan’s Origin Clock is nurtured with the ‘Source of Metallicity,’ its growth rate will significantly increase.

In the classification of numerous treasures and rare items by human civilization, the Source of Metallicity ranks as a Twelve-Star, and it’s a top-tier Twelve-Star, belonging to the same category as the World Tree.

“No problem.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji waved his hand again, and a burst of golden radiance appeared, suspended in front of Lin Yuan.

“Is this the ‘Source of Metallicity’?” Lin Yuan looked it over for a while, took the golden radiance, and then turned his attention to the Fifth Layer reward list.

“Have you thought about which reward to choose from these?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji, showing interest, looked at Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan had previously seen the Fifth Layer reward list and had hesitated; he knew this.

“I’ve thought about it.”

Lin Yuan nodded, “I’ll take this one.”

“This one?” Stone Statue Shen Ji showed a hint of surprise on his face.

On the Fifth Layer reward list, there were ultimate weapons for both offense and defense, as well as a few heritage secret techniques.

Stone Statue originally thought Lin Yuan would choose an ultimate defensive weapon but, instead…

“Heritage ‘Milky Way’…” Lin Yuan turned towards the heritage secret techniques, his gaze slightly fervent.

If it had been before his fall into that two-dimensional world, Lin Yuan indeed would have hesitated over the Fifth Layer reward list.

He wanted both the heritage secret techniques and the ultimate weapons.

But now?

Having journeyed through the two-dimensional world, Lin Yuan had acquired nearly a hundred rare items, the least of which were ultimate weapons.

Of course, even among ultimate weapons, there are levels of superiority and inferiority, and the ultimate weapons on the Fifth Layer reward list are somewhat better than those rare items.

However, for beings below the ultimate level, unless the ultimate weapons are particularly suitable for them, there is basically no difference in this regard.

Because even the lowest tier ultimate weapons cannot unleash their full potential by an Eleventh Rank powerhouse, so they are pretty much the same.

“This is the bearer of the secret technique ‘Milky Way’.” The Six-Armed Silhouette waved his right hand, and a circular crystal appeared, landing in Lin Yuan’s hand.

“Once you return, just connect with it through your consciousness,” Stone Statue Shen Ji briefly said.

“Okay.” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Next is the Sixth Layer reward list.” Stone Statue Shen Ji’s gaze carried a hint of a different shade, the virtual light screen changed rapidly, displaying a new reward list.

“These?”

Lin Yuan glanced over, his expression subtly changing.
